Displayed allocation overlap warnings retain their original arithmetic and severity, including monthly positive overlaps that need not equal net annual residual; all broad fan energy stays unassigned. The earlier closed 20260907T163041 capture and its 16,765-check passing fallback-only diagnostic remain preserved, but they do not approve the required direct PTAC component consumption. The current exact source recipe now targets real-ptac-25-1-20260908T081443.664544900, SQL SHA256 37372221dba622dc0e71b5574edba740f316fd973ea6fbcb9655311053674090, executed input SHA256 0f4ebdffe490fcd3280ef11dac8482a46924eb57e859cdb616769c15c6485859. Coil sensible/total Energy/Rate sources are five equipment-key observations, not extra Zone load or site consumption. People, Lights, ElectricEquipment and ZoneInfiltration:DesignFlowRate each have exactly the five SPACE owners and matching Monthly SQL sources. Only the five SPACE outdoor-air balance families subtract their actual infiltration components; PLENUM-1 retains outdoor.unsplit and does not acquire a fabricated infiltration source. Subtractions outside declared component membership are arithmetic zero, not new source observations. Every one of the 330 Monthly dictionary identities has twelve finite non-warmup Weather observations and twelve distinct months, with no duplicate exact name/key/unit/meter/frequency identity. The executed Monthly plan supplies all forty-two declared availability groups (drivers19, loads14, endUses7, carriers2); absent requested output groups remain missing, not unrequested or known zero. These common DOAS heat-recovery observations are inspector context and are not reassigned as five Zone latent loads. There are no Ideal Loads objects or Ideal latent detail declarations, and neither approved Hourly surface/internal reconciliation trace identity exists in this capture, so no NonAdditiveLoadDetails or TemporalTrace declarations are copied. The nine site declarations select actual Monthly/J Cooling:Electricity, Heating:Electricity, Heating:NaturalGas, Fans:Electricity, InteriorLights:Electricity, InteriorEquipment:Electricity, HeatRecovery:Electricity, Electricity:Facility and NaturalGas:Facility. Heating:Electricity and HeatRecovery:Electricity both have twelve finite known-zero observations and remain explicit source checks. The two direct-use declarations bind only the five SPACE Zone Lights Electricity Energy and Zone Electric Equipment Electricity Energy observations; each month their sums independently match the matching broad meter. Annual ABUPS End Uses, Entire Facility, kWh confirms electricity cooling/fans/interior-lighting/interior-equipment and Natural Gas heating; facility totals agree with independently summed Monthly site observations. Its displayed cells are corroborating report evidence, not replacement Monthly inputs; district, exterior-lighting, water-system and pump site sources are not invented. Fans:Electricity contains the five local PTAC fans plus the DOAS fan. No Fan Electricity Energy/Rate or Air System Fan Electricity Energy/Rate identity is reported at any frequency, and no measured per-pool supply-flow source exists. Therefore fanPools is empty and the complete original broad fan observation remains explicitly unassigned under the existing fail-closed auxiliary contract. Its empty eligible ServedZones means no defensible measured allocation pool, not absent physical equipment ownership; the broad total must not be equated to the DOAS pool or shared using invented individual fan consumption. The runtime copy alone replaces the two original one-day RunPeriods with fixed 2017 January 1 through December 31, disables holiday/DST variation, and applies the recorded Basic Energy Path Monthly output plan, retaining original equipment, geometry, schedules and timestep. Original, annual and executed input hashes remain separate. The official model identifies Miami while this catalog deliberately uses unchanged Chicago weather SHA256 c7d4efcf93ba316a1d874352e743df5cf137ba5c0e3459eb2dc4b5442d5b7f5c. The saved EnergyPlus run completed with zero Severe and 5278 warnings, including five DX low-condenser-temperature recurring warnings and one SPACE3 freeze-risk warning. Warnings and original model bytes are retained, not suppressed or calibrated away. Engine success and this output-conversion validation do not certify climate suitability or physical design adequacy. Shared precision and Monthly-before-Annual arithmetic are unchanged. End of historical baseline review.
